literal_meaning: পাথরে কিল/কোপ মারা (driving a nail or striking a blow on stone)
similar_in_english: Banging one's head against a wall
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার সব চেষ্টা পাথরে কিল মারার মতো নিস্ফল হয়ে গেল।
এই কাজে পাথরে কোপ মারার মতোই লাভ নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: All his efforts turned out to be as futile as driving a nail into stone.
There's no point in this task; it's like striking a blow on stone.
note: This idiom draws from everyday imagery of attempting the impossible with basic tools, common in rural Bengali life.
